Opportunity counts are regulation nflverse pass and run plays. Overtime is a separate block. Kneels are not carries.
Explosive counts are derived from yards_gained. There is no official explosive label.

scrimmage_plays.definition: Pass and run plays by the offense. Kneels, spikes, kicks, and no-plays are excluded.

unknown_down_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with no down by the offense.

early_down_run_plays.definition: Early-down run plays, including scrambles and excluding kneels.

early_down_pass_rate.definition: Early-down pass plays divided by early-down scrimmage plays.

early_down_run_rate.definition: Early-down run plays divided by early-down scrimmage plays.

neutral_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with pre-play score margin from -7 to +7, including ties. Positive means the offense leads.

leading_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with the offense ahead by 8 or more before the snap.

trailing_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with the offense behind by 8 or more before the snap.

tied_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with the score tied before the snap. These plays are also inside the neutral count.

unknown_score_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with no pre-play score margin.

neutral_pass_rate.definition: Pass rate when the pre-play margin is between -7 and +7.

leading_pass_rate.definition: Pass rate when the offense leads by 8 or more.

trailing_pass_rate.definition: Pass rate when the offense trails by 8 or more.

tied_pass_rate.definition: Pass rate when the score is tied before the snap.

short_yardage_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with 2 or fewer yards to go.

long_yardage_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with 7 or more yards to go.

short_yardage_pass_rate.definition: Pass rate on scrimmage plays with 2 or fewer yards to go.

long_yardage_pass_rate.definition: Pass rate on scrimmage plays with 7 or more yards to go.

third_down_plays.definition: Third-down pass, run, kneel, and spike plays. Official gamebook attempts include kneels and spikes. Two-point tries are excluded.

third_down_conversions.definition: Those third-down plays with nflverse third_down_converted = 1.

third_down_failures.definition: Those third-down plays with nflverse third_down_failed = 1.

third_down_unknown_results.definition: Third-down plays with neither conversion flag. The result is unknown, not a failure.

third_down_conversion_rate.definition: Third-down conversions divided by third-down pass, run, kneel, and spike plays.

red_zone_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with yardline_100 <= 20, the snap at or inside the opponent 20.

unknown_yardline_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with no yardline_100. They are not treated as outside the red zone.

red_zone_pass_rate.definition: Pass rate on red-zone scrimmage plays.

red_zone_touchdown_plays.definition: Red-zone scrimmage plays with touchdown = 1. This is a play count, not an official red-zone trip.

red_zone_drives.definition: Drives with a scrimmage snap at or inside the 20 by the offense, keyed by game, posteam, and fixed_drive. Derived, not the official trip count.

red_zone_drives_with_touchdown.definition: Those derived red-zone drives that also have a scrimmage touchdown.

red_zone_drives_with_made_field_goal.definition: Those derived red-zone drives that also have a made field goal on the same drive key.

red_zone_drive_touchdown_rate.definition: Derived red-zone drives with a touchdown, divided by derived red-zone drives.

unknown_drive_red_zone_plays.definition: Red-zone scrimmage plays with no fixed_drive. They stay in the play count and out of the drive rate.

unknown_drive_field_goals.definition: Made field goals that could not be joined to a drive key. They are not counted as zero red-zone field goals.

official_red_zone_trip_efficiency.reason: Official red-zone trip efficiency is printed on gamebooks. It is stored only on the games that were opened, and it is not averaged into a season rate.

explosive_pass_20_plays.definition: Complete passes with yards_gained >= 20. Derived from play yards. Not an official explosive label.

explosive_pass_20_rate.definition: Complete passes of 20 or more yards divided by pass plays, including sacks and incompletions.

explosive_rush_10_plays.definition: Run plays with yards_gained >= 10. Derived. Not an official explosive label.

explosive_rush_10_rate.definition: Run plays of 10 or more yards divided by run plays.

explosive_rush_15_plays.definition: Run plays with yards_gained >= 15. Derived. A second threshold already used in this repo's team database, reported separately and not substituted for the 10-yard count.

explosive_rush_15_rate.definition: Run plays of 15 or more yards divided by run plays.

official_explosive_label.reason: Neither the gamebook tables nor nflverse play-by-play carry an official explosive-play label.

sacks.definition: Sacks by the offense. A sack is a pass play with sack = 1.

sack_rate.definition: Sacks divided by pass plays by the offense.

qb_scrambles.definition: Run plays with qb_scramble = 1 by the offense. Designed quarterback runs stay in the run count and are not called scrambles.

qb_scramble_rate.definition: Scrambles divided by pass plays plus scrambles. Kneels are not dropbacks.

qb_kneels.definition: Quarterback kneels. Excluded from scrimmage rates and from carry shares. Included in third-down attempts and in the gamebook rushing comparison.

qb_spikes.definition: Quarterback spikes. Excluded from pass-rate denominators. Included in third-down attempts, matching the official gamebook.

two_point_attempts.definition: Two-point conversion attempts. Not scrimmage plays, not targets, and not carries. A missing flag is not counted as zero attempts unless the column was scanned.

shotgun_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with nflverse shotgun = 1. This is a formation label, not a personnel package.

unknown_shotgun_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with no shotgun flag. They are not counted as under center.

shotgun_rate.definition: Shotgun plays divided by scrimmage plays that have a shotgun flag.

explosive_rush_15_plays.definition: Run plays with yards_gained >= 15. Derived. A second threshold already used in this repo's team database, reported separately and not substituted for the 10-yard count.

explosive_rush_15_rate.definition: Run plays of 15 or more yards divided by run plays.

official_explosive_label.reason: Neither the gamebook tables nor nflverse play-by-play carry an official explosive-play label.

sacks.definition: Sacks allowed by the defense. A sack is a pass play with sack = 1.

sack_rate.definition: Sacks divided by pass plays allowed by the defense.

qb_scrambles.definition: Run plays with qb_scramble = 1 allowed by the defense. Designed quarterback runs stay in the run count and are not called scrambles.

qb_scramble_rate.definition: Scrambles divided by pass plays plus scrambles. Kneels are not dropbacks.

qb_kneels.definition: Quarterback kneels. Excluded from scrimmage rates and from carry shares. Included in third-down attempts and in the gamebook rushing comparison.

qb_spikes.definition: Quarterback spikes. Excluded from pass-rate denominators. Included in third-down attempts, matching the official gamebook.

two_point_attempts.definition: Two-point conversion attempts. Not scrimmage plays, not targets, and not carries. A missing flag is not counted as zero attempts unless the column was scanned.

shotgun_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with nflverse shotgun = 1. This is a formation label, not a personnel package.

unknown_shotgun_plays.definition: Scrimmage plays with no shotgun flag. They are not counted as under center.

shotgun_rate.definition: Shotgun plays divided by scrimmage plays that have a shotgun flag.

plays.definition: Run plays scanned for direction allowed by the defense.

unknown.definition: Run plays whose nflverse run_location is missing or outside ['left', 'middle', 'right']. Missing is unknown, not a direction.

plays.definition: Run plays with run_location left allowed by the defense.

share_of_runs.definition: Share of run plays with run_location left. Unknown direction stays in the unknown count and is not recoded.

plays.definition: Run plays with run_location middle allowed by the defense.

share_of_runs.definition: Share of run plays with run_location middle. Unknown direction stays in the unknown count and is not recoded.

plays.definition: Run plays with run_location right allowed by the defense.

share_of_runs.definition: Share of run plays with run_location right. Unknown direction stays in the unknown count and is not recoded.

plays.definition: Run plays scanned for gap allowed by the defense.

unknown.definition: Run plays whose nflverse run_gap is missing or outside ['end', 'guard', 'tackle']. Missing is unknown, not a direction.

plays.definition: Run plays with run_gap end allowed by the defense.

share_of_runs.definition: Share of run plays with run_gap end. Unknown gap stays in the unknown count and is not recoded.

plays.definition: Run plays with run_gap guard allowed by the defense.

share_of_runs.definition: Share of run plays with run_gap guard. Unknown gap stays in the unknown count and is not recoded.

plays.definition: Run plays with run_gap tackle allowed by the defense.

share_of_runs.definition: Share of run plays with run_gap tackle. Unknown gap stays in the unknown count and is not recoded.

unassigned_pass_plays.definition: Pass plays, including sacks, with no receiver id. Sacks and throwaways stay unassigned. They are not a player with zero targets.

unassigned_rushes.definition: Run plays with no rusher id. Kneels are a separate play type and are not carries.

unassigned_pass_plays.definition: Pass plays, including sacks, with no receiver id. Sacks and throwaways stay unassigned. They are not a player with zero targets.

unassigned_rushes.definition: Run plays with no rusher id. Kneels are a separate play type and are not carries.

unassigned_pass_plays.definition: Pass plays, including sacks, with no receiver id. Sacks and throwaways stay unassigned. They are not a player with zero targets.

unassigned_rushes.definition: Run plays with no rusher id. Kneels are a separate play type and are not carries.

early_down_pass_rate.definition: Early-down pass plays divided by early-down scrimmage plays.

earlier_early_down_pass_rate.definition: Early-down pass plays divided by early-down scrimmage plays.

early_down_pass_rate_difference.definition: Early-down pass rate in the last 5 games minus the rate in earlier completed games. Unknown when the earlier sample is empty.

early_down_pass_rate.definition: Early-down pass plays divided by early-down scrimmage plays.

earlier_early_down_pass_rate.definition: Early-down pass rate. No earlier games were scanned.
earlier_early_down_pass_rate.reason: denominator is zero; the rate is unknown, not zero

early_down_pass_rate_difference.definition: Early-down pass rate in the last 8 games minus the rate in earlier completed games. Unknown when the earlier sample is empty.
early_down_pass_rate_difference.reason: one side of the comparison has no scanned sample
